# Vendor

## PixelOffice

[PixelOffice](https://github.com/KalebKE/PixelOffice) is the office picture. It is a git submodule at `vendor/PixelOffice`, pinned to one upstream commit.

PixelOffice is Apache License 2.0. See `vendor/PixelOffice/LICENSE`. It is not MIT, and this repository does not relicense it. HarnessOffice itself stays GPL-3.0.

```bash
git submodule update --init --depth 1 vendor/PixelOffice
```
